Pedal efficiency 0.8 (24-25 workbook); efficiency of 1.0 is disallowed. Pad mu 0.48 is the conservative end of the Brembo H38 band; Brembo H38 data in the SDM26 Design Binder (p26) gives mu 0.48-0.6 over 100-480 C with a 500 C cap. See data/materials/pad_compounds.yaml.

assumptions.source: Brembo H38 data (SDM26 Design Binder p26): mu 0.48-0.60 over 100-480 C, 500 C cap. Design value set to the conservative end (0.48). See data/materials/pad_compounds.yaml.
